EN_R03_TEXT: The direction-ignored first-order structural view \(U(G_{\mathrm{RefQ}})\), obtained from the directed cross-project edges by ignoring direction and merging reciprocal relations, is broadly connected within the seed-centered observed RefQN: its largest connected component covers 97.86% of the node domain, a small number of other components and isolates remain, and local clustering is low (Table 4.6e; Figure 3A). Figure 3B compares LCC coverage, average clustering, and modularity for this canonical seed-centered observed view with the two other declared observation-boundary views. The seed-only induced view retains cross-project RefQ edges whose source and target are both among the 294 seed projects, while retaining all 294 seeds in its node domain. The multi-seed target view retains cross-project RefQ edges whose target is referenced by at least two distinct seed sources and uses the union of the seed set and those multi-seed targets as its node domain. The undirected view remains first-order rather than a second-order projection (§3.3.3); its interpretation under source-incomplete observation of expanded targets is discussed in §6.3.
